models.title: Built-in models

details.whisperTiny: For whisper.cpp. Fast multilingual transcription with the lowest resource use, suited to modest hardware with limited accuracy. CPU supported; GPU weights use about 0.07 GiB.
details.whisperBase: For whisper.cpp. Lightweight multilingual transcription, more accurate than Tiny and suited to clear speech. CPU supported; GPU weights use about 0.14 GiB.
details.whisperSmall: For whisper.cpp. Multilingual transcription balancing accuracy and speed with moderate resource use. CPU supported; GPU weights use about 0.45 GiB.
details.whisperLargeV3: For whisper.cpp. Multilingual transcription focused on accuracy, with slower processing and high resource use. CPU supported; GPU weights use about 2.88 GiB.
details.whisperLargeV3Turbo: For whisper.cpp. Faster than Large v3 with a small accuracy tradeoff; repetition and hallucinations remain possible. CPU supported; GPU weights use about 1.51 GiB.
details.paraformerZh: For sherpa-onnx. Fast, non-autoregressive recognition focused on Chinese, including mixed Chinese and English speech. Moderate resource use; runs on CPU; GPU weights use about 0.77 GiB.
details.senseVoiceSmall: For sherpa-onnx. Fast recognition of Mandarin, Cantonese, English, Japanese and Korean, with text timestamps. Low resource use with INT8; CPU preferred; GPU weights use about 0.22 GiB.
details.fireRedAsr2Ctc: For sherpa-onnx. CTC recognition for Chinese, English, mixed speech and Chinese dialects, with text timestamps. Moderate resource use with INT8; CPU preferred; GPU weights use about 0.72 GiB.
details.qwen3Asr06b: For sherpa-onnx. Supports 30 languages and Chinese dialects, including singing and songs with accompaniment. Focuses on efficiency, with moderate INT8 memory use and CPU support; GPU weights use about 0.92 GiB; text timestamps are currently unavailable.
details.qwen3Asr17b: For sherpa-onnx. Supports 30 languages and Chinese dialects, including singing and songs with accompaniment. Focuses on accuracy, with higher INT8 memory use, slower processing and CPU support; GPU weights use about 2.23 GiB; text timestamps are currently unavailable.

about.name: Vestige (理学)
about.description:
A workspace for editing and proofreading transcripts, and exploring the archaeology of your own life.
We preserve memories to keep a doorway to another possibility, at least in our hearts.
With them, we can live our lives over, thousands upon thousands of times.
about.quote:
I have made many choices. Some quietly, without noticing; others after careful thought. In happiness and in sorrow. Some of my own accord, others under pressure. Some fell naturally into place; others came about by chance.
I know that, long from now, somewhere, one night, I will remember the roads to the rose garden that I never took.
I chose one road, and that has made all the difference.
